cohort: Pregnant women admitted to the Critical Maternal Care Center in Suqian City, Jiangsu Province, China, between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2019, with severe pregnancy complications or comorbidities.
finding: The top three causes of maternal near miss (MNM) in the Suqian area were placenta previa, postpartum hemorrhage, and hypertension in pregnancy.
